69. Activation of the sympathetic nervous system corresponds to arousal and energy
generation- the so called “fight and flight”- response. Which of the following is an
example of this?
a) Stimulation of activity of the stomach and intestine.
b) Stimulation of salivary glands.
c) Stimulation of glucose release from liver.
d) Constriction of bronchi in the lungs.
